name: AMC Arrange Board
description: Experimental: plain regions become a personal dashboard; every user can reorder, resize and collapse the regions that share one parent with keyboard-friendly header buttons, and the layout is remembered per page, with no dashboard plug-in and no server-side personalisation tables.
useFor: Home pages and dashboards built from ordinary regions: Charts, Cards, Classic and Interactive Reports, Static Content and small Forms that users want in their own order and size.
helpText: EXPERIMENTAL living region template (behaviour-aware). Setup: give every region that should be arrangeable this template and place them together, either as sub regions of one parent region (the parent may use any template, including this one, and then acts as a plain frame) or in the same page position, one after another; give each region a Static ID so stored layouts survive page changes. The script finds the regions that share a parent, turns that parent into a 12-column CSS grid board, flattens the APEX grid rows and columns in between with display: contents (so the Page Designer column spans no longer apply to these regions) and lets any other content in that parent span the full width. If the markup between a region and the shared parent holds other visible content, or more than three wrapper levels, the group is left alone and its regions keep only the collapse button. Confirm the APEX grid markup around the regions on a live page before production use. Each region header gets a toolbar of real buttons: Move earlier and Move later (aria-disabled at the ends), width Small, Medium or Large (4, 6 or 12 of 12 columns, aria-pressed; Small becomes half width on a board narrower than 880 pixels and every region is full width below 560 pixels), and a collapse button with aria-expanded. Moving a region moves its grid wrapper in the DOM, so the tab order always follows the visual order; focus returns to the pressed button and the move is announced through a polite live region, for example Open orders moved to position 2 of 4. A bar above the board shows Default layout or Your layout, saved in this browser, and a Reset layout button that restores the original order, widths and collapsed state. Order, widths and collapsed state are stored in localStorage per application and page (key amc-tpl-arrange-board:APP_ID:PAGE_ID) and nothing leaves the browser. Keyboard only works throughout; drag and drop is not provided. After a move or resize the page receives a resize event so charts redraw; regions containing an iframe reload when moved. The region body is never clipped or transformed. Without JavaScript the regions keep the normal APEX layout and the toolbar is hidden. Template options: Default width Small and Default width Large set the starting width, Medium otherwise; Collapsed by default starts the region collapsed until the user expands it; Fixed width hides the width buttons for this region; No body padding runs reports edge to edge. English UI strings to translate in the template: the toolbar label Arrange, the button texts and tooltips Move earlier, Move later, Small width, Medium width, Large width, Show content, Collapse or expand, the letters S, M and L, and the data-amc attributes on the region element: reset Reset layout, default Default layout, custom Your layout, saved in this browser, moved %0 moved to position %1 of %2, sized %0 width: %1, collapsed %0 collapsed, expanded %0 expanded, reset-done Layout reset to default; %0 is the region title. The bar takes its strings from the first region of the board. Under reduced motion nothing animates. JavaScript API: amcTplArrangeBoard.reset(element), amcTplArrangeBoard.boards(), amcTplArrangeBoard.init().

templateOptions.name: Default width Small
templateOptions.help: Starts at 4 of 12 columns until the user picks another width. For KPI and small chart regions.

templateOptions.name: Default width Large
templateOptions.help: Starts at the full board width until the user picks another width. For reports.

templateOptions.name: Collapsed by default
templateOptions.help: Starts collapsed to its header until the user expands it; the user's choice is remembered. Without JavaScript the region stays expanded.

templateOptions.name: Fixed width
templateOptions.help: Hides the width buttons for this region; it can still be moved and collapsed.

templateOptions.name: No body padding
templateOptions.help: Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge.
